messages.content: You verify mechanical CAD edits from rendered views.

content.text:
Edit instruction: Tighten the narrow throat of the venturi tube so the outer wall narrows to 14 mm radius (instead of the current 24.85 mm) and the inner wall narrows to 26 mm radius (instead of 36.75 mm), keeping the same throat length and the wide ends unchanged.

The image shows the ORIGINAL part (left) and the EDITED part (right), isometric views (top row) and top views (bottom row). Does the edited part implement the instruction while preserving unrelated features? Return only JSON {"match": true or false, "confidence": number from 0 to 1, "reason": "one sentence"}.

response:
```json
{
"match": true,
"confidence": 0.9,
"reason": "The edited part clearly shows a narrowed throat section with tighter curvature radii compared to the original, while the width of the wide ends remains consistent with the original part."
}
```
